text:
Sam (PM): Team — final pass on the design-partner onboarding protocol. We need clear rules for staged feedback windows, timeboxing eng effort, what counts as actionable input, how to replace partners quickly, and the incentive mix. Planning to publish the playbook at 10:00 PT.

Vera (Eng): Suggest a "staged" feedback model: week 0 = onboarding & smoke test, weeks 1-2 = rapid feedback window (high-touch), weeks 3-6 = consolidation (lower-touch). High-touch partners get a dedicated 2h/week office-hour slot; low-touch get async 72h SLA.

Noel (Solutions): Recruitment scoring: production usage (40), willingness to schedule calls (25), clear owner/sponsor (20), security/compliance risk (15 negative if present). We'll ask candidates to self-report weekly available hours.

Priya (SRE): Ops cap: we can reserve 10h/week SE time for the whole cohort. Recommend per-high-touch partner cap = 2h/week. Also require that partner traffic be tagged pilot=true and routed to isolated quota buckets to protect other customers.

Ava (Design): To reduce partner burden, require a 4-question milestone survey and at most two recorded sessions in the first 30 days for high-touch. Keep forms scannable; first question should be "Can this be actioned in <=2 sprints? (yes/no)".

Sam (PM): Draft protocol I propose to publish:
- Slots: 8 total (3 High-touch / 3 Low-touch / 2 Float)
- Time commitments: High-touch ~2h/week; Low-touch ~1h/2w
- SE cap: 10h/week total (2h/High-touch max)
- Feedback windows: Rapid feedback window = first 14 days (priority triage); Consolidation = next 30 days (eval + follow-ups)
- KV warm-cache: opt-in only for High-touch, single window max 8 days, auto-teardown
- Incentives: High-touch = $900 credit + small paid micro-bounties ($150) for on-time milestone completion; Low-touch = $250 credit
- Early-bird bonus: $300 if partner provides 3 actionable items in week 1 that get scoped as tickets

Vera (Eng): Clarify "actionable": an item is actionable if we can scope and assign it to an engineering sprint with estimated effort <= 2 weeks and no infra changes requiring >1PR approval. Document examples in the playbook.

Noel (Solutions): Replacement rules: missing definition — propose probation flow: miss 2 required feedback milestones or miss 2 scheduled calls w/o reschedule -> probation notice. Probation = 72h to respond; if no engagement, slot marked released and pilot-bot invites waitlist top candidate with 48h to accept.

pilot-bot: probation workflow enabled: send automated probation email -> 72h response window -> if no action mark slot "released" and send waitlist invite (48h accept window).

Priya (SRE): Failure modes we should enumerate in playbook: noisy neighbor (rate limits), data leakage (telemetry safeguards), long-lived KV state, and regressions to baseline customers. For regressions we execute rollback/canary within 12h and tag the incident with pilot_slot_id.

Ava (Design): UX for invites: show a "time commitment" badge (High-touch=~2h/wk, Low-touch=~1h/2w), checklist of onboarding steps (smoke test, kickoff recording, baseline survey), and checkbox for telemetry consent. Also include a short "what success looks like" bullet list.

Sam (PM): Acceptance gates to mark partner active: smoke test green, baseline survey returned, kickoff recorded, telemetry consent (if opted-in). Program success metrics: avg structured feedback >=6/10, >=2 actionable items implemented per cohort in first 30 days, and partner sentiment >= 0.

Vera (Eng): Telemetry & debug rules: enable high-detail traces only after a signed addendum. Debug bundles auto-expire after 30 days. Tag metrics with partner_id. KV warm-cache namespace must have auto-teardown and a memory cap.

Noel (Solutions): Recruitment email draft: "Short: we're inviting a small set of partners to help shape Redwood Dedicated. High-touch asks ~2h/week (calls + short forms). Incentive: $900 credit + micro-bounty for on-time feedback. Can you commit? Please share POC, timezone, and security contact."

Priya (SRE): Compliance note: if partner is in regulated sector (health/finance), flag as high-compliance in the sheet. Those take longer (7-14 day security intake) and require named approver. Consider offering a separate paced track.

Ava (Design): Measurement to capture: milestone completion rate, feedback actionability fraction, avg response latency, and partner sentiment (-2..+2). Show per-slot and cohort rollup in dashboard.

Sam (PM): One more: propose a "feature-escrow" rule — if a partner requests a product change that team agrees to prototype during the pilot, we log it as "scoped prototype" and not a committed roadmap item; if partner funds it, create a scoped change order. Avoid promising timeline.

Vera (Eng): Ops constraint: avoid scheduling >2 High-touch partners that share the exact same 4-hour window of SE availability. Add timezone cap column to the sheet.

Sam (PM): OK I'll fold this into a one-pager, recruitment sheet, and the pilot playbook. Quick thumbs?

Vera (Eng): :thumbsup:
Noel (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Priya (SRE): :thumbsup:
Ava (Design): :thumbsup:

Sam (PM): Thanks — publishing at 10:00 PT and will feed pilot-bot the invite CSV. Ping me if anything pops up tonight.
